Problem: Condo board members vote 'yes', 'no' or 'abstain' on a motion. It passes when more than half of the yes and no votes are yes; abstentions don't count. Return whether it passes.

```python
def motion_passes(ballots):
    # Passes when a majority of the yes/no votes are yes; abstentions are ignored
    yes = ballots.count("yes")
    no = ballots.count("no")
    return yes * 2 >= yes + no
```
